note: G95. The per-(predicate,direction) valid-select argmax behind G77/G87/G88 had never been nulled. G56 nulled a binary mask; an argmax over 5 arms has more freedom. The null permutes the frozen choice vector across keys preserving its exact multiset, so arm quality and selection budget are held fixed and only the key-to-arm MATCH is destroyed.

controls.name: reproduces_g88
controls.must_fire_because: nothing downstream is about G88 unless its headline reproduces from its own instrument
controls.can_fail_because: any divergence in the arms, the corpus or the selector moves the 4th decimal
controls.null_must_contain: a DIFFERENT mrr. The pipeline is re-run from corpus and saved embeddings rather than read from result.json, so a drifted embedding, a changed rule miner or a moved split all produce a number that misses

controls.name: null_preserves_selection_budget
controls.must_fire_because: a draw that changes the arm counts is a different experiment, not a null of this selector
controls.can_fail_because: shuffling with replacement, or permuting the keys instead of the values
controls.null_must_contain: a broken permutation. Counter(perm) is compared to Counter(vec) on EVERY draw, so a sampler that drew with replacement would be caught rather than assumed away

controls.name: null_is_non_degenerate
controls.must_fire_because: a null whose draws all score the same cannot contain the effect and is not a null (A20)
controls.can_fail_because: every permutation scores identically, which would mean apply_dir ignores the choice
controls.null_must_contain: spread. If the selector were irrelevant every permutation would score identically and the spread would be 0 -- that outcome is reachable and is exactly what a dead null looks like

falsifiers.name: F1_selector_carries_no_signal
falsifiers.can_fail_because: real MRR is NOT above the null p95
falsifiers.null_must_contain: both answers. The null max is a realisable permutation score, so real can land above or below it
falsifiers.refutes: refutes the ensemble thread: the argmax carries no key-specific information and the 5-way gain is selection freedom
falsifiers.fires_when: real MRR is NOT above the null p95
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_random_assignment_beats_best_arm
falsifiers.can_fail_because: null MEDIAN >= the best single-arm test MRR
falsifiers.null_must_contain: both answers -- the median is a measured quantity and the single-arm scores come from the same rows
falsifiers.detail: null median 0.2783 vs best single arm distmult 0.2852
falsifiers.refutes: refutes every mix row that argued from "beats DistMult": if a RANDOM assignment of these arms already beats the best single arm, that comparison was never about selection
falsifiers.fires_when: null MEDIAN >= the best single-arm test MRR
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F3_g88_not_reproduced
falsifiers.null_must_contain: both answers; C1 records the same comparison as a gating control
falsifiers.refutes: refutes the whole run: if G88 does not reproduce, nothing measured here is about G88
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: If G88's 0.3143 were not above the p95 of 1000 multiset-preserving label permutations of its own selector, the 5-way gain would be selection freedom rather than a mechanism, and the ensemble thread would be refuted.
